The issue may be that mise 2026 requires new plugin/registry. Let me check `mise ls --json` or reinstall those two.

Actually the awscli install via aqua:aws/aws-cli. And 1password-cli uses asdf/vfox plugin. The bin path detection may have failed. Let me reinstall them.
